scripts.title: FieldKit - A customizable touchscreen HUD and control tool
scripts.features:
FieldKit — Features

- Touchscreen Controls: Customizable on-screen keyboard inputs and joystick for mobile gameplay.
- Custom HUD Editor: Freely position, resize, reshape, recolor, and adjust the opacity of controls.
- Per-Key Settings: Configure individual hold durations and permanent-hold options.
- Configuration Saving: Save and restore customized control layouts.
- In-Game UI Toggle: Open and close the FieldKit interface using its floating football icon.


How FieldKit Helps Android Players

FieldKit makes gameplay more comfortable on Android by giving players greater control over their touchscreen layout.

- Custom Touch Controls: Use on-screen keyboard inputs and a joystick to make controls more accessible on mobile.
- Personalized HUD: Move, resize, reshape, recolor, and adjust the opacity of controls to suit your screen and playstyle.
- Individual Hold Settings: Configure hold durations and permanent-hold options for supported controls.
- Save Your Layout: Save and reload your preferred control configuration instead of rebuilding it every time.
- Quick UI Access: Open or close FieldKit using the floating football icon without searching for the interface.

The goal: give Android players more flexibility over how they control the game, with a customizable setup that feels more natural on a touchscreen.

                end

                local function dropCurrentTool()
                    if not isCharacterValid() then return end
                    local heldTool = initialCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")

                        for _, desc in ipairs(heldTool:GetDescendants()) do

                            end

                        heldTool.Parent = game.Workspace

                        dropCurrentTool()
                    end
                    task.wait(0.1)

                    if EquipToolEvent then EquipToolEvent:FireServer("Flashlight") end
                    
                    local activeFlashlight = backpack:WaitForChild("Flashlight", 2)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- Unified Chat System Payload Broadcaster
local function sendLocalChat(text)
    task.spawn(function()
        if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
            local channel = TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
            if channel then channel:SendAsync(text) end

            local cEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents") and ReplicatedStorage.DefaultChatSystemChatEvents:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest")
            if cEvent then cEvent:FireServer(text, "All") end
        end
    end)
end

-- Core Tool Assembly Engine
local function buildCustomTools()
    local backpack = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("Backpack")
    
    -- 1. Assemble Ragdoll Tool Instance
    if not backpack:FindFirstChild("Ragdoll (Sit)") then
        local RagdollTool = Instance.new("Tool")
        RagdollTool.Name = "Ragdoll (Sit)"
        RagdollTool.RequiresHandle = false
        RagdollTool.CanBeDropped = false
        
        RagdollTool.Activated:Connect(function()
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                hum.Sit = not hum.Sit
                if hum.Sit then 
                    hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated) 
                end
            end
        end)
        RagdollTool.Parent = backpack
    end
    
    -- 2. Assemble Face Slam Tool Instance
    if not backpack:FindFirstChild("Face Slam") then
        local SlamTool = Instance.new("Tool")
        SlamTool.Name = "Face Slam"
        SlamTool.RequiresHandle = false
        SlamTool.CanBeDropped = false
        
        local activeConnection = nil
        local activeAnchors = {}
        
        SlamTool.Activated:Connect(function()
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            
            if not hum or not root or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
            
            -- Clear old tracking frames if activated back-to-back
            if activeConnection then activeConnection:Disconnect() activeConnection = nil end
            for _, p in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                if p:IsA("BasePart") and activeAnchors[p] then p.Anchored = false end
            end
            table.clear(activeAnchors)
            
            -- Broadcast chat string payload
            sendLocalChat("slam*")
            
            -- Unlock stand-up animation states
            root.Anchored = true

local function generateCoordinateQueue(center2D)
	local queue = {}
	
	local function addLineToQueue(p1, p2, steps)
		for i = 0, steps do
			table.insert(queue, p1:Lerp(p2, i / steps))
		end
	end

	if currentShape == "Circle" then
		local stepDistance = 2.5 
		for r = shapeSize, 0, -stepDistance do
			local currentPoints = math.max(8, math.floor(density * (r / shapeSize) * 2))
			for i = 1, currentPoints do
				local rad = math.rad((i / currentPoints) * 360)
				table.insert(queue, center2D + Vector2.new(math.cos(rad), math.sin(rad)) * r)
			end
		end
		
	elseif currentShape == "Cube" then
		local steps = density
		local half = shapeSize / 2
		for i = 0, steps do
			local t = i / steps
			local leftX = center2D.X - half
			local rightX = center2D.X + half
			local currentZ = (center2D.Y + half) - (t * shapeSize)
			addLineToQueue(Vector2.new(leftX, currentZ), Vector2.new(rightX, currentZ), steps)
		end
		
	elseif currentShape == "Triangle" then
		local steps = density
		local top = center2D + Vector2.new(0, shapeSize)
		local bottomLeft = center2D + Vector2.new(-shapeSize, -shapeSize)
		local bottomRight = center2D + Vector2.new(shapeSize, -shapeSize)
		
		for i = 0, steps do
			local t = i / steps
			local leftPoint = top:Lerp(bottomLeft, t)
			local rightPoint = top:Lerp(bottomRight, t)
			addLineToQueue(leftPoint, rightPoint, math.floor(steps * t))
		end
	end
	
	return queue
end

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if not noclipEnabled then return end

    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end

    for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            part.CanCollide = false
        end
    end
end)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(0.5)
    if noclipEnabled then
        setNoclip(true)
    end
end)

scripts.title: Epics hub template
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "EpicScriptHubGui"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = playerGui

local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30)
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.ClipsDescendants = false
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

local isMobile = UserInputService:GetPlatform() == Enum.Platform.IOS or UserInputService:GetPlatform() == Enum.Platform.Android

if isMobile then
	mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0.65, 0, 0.8, 0)
	mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.175, 0, 0.1, 0)
else
	mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 500, 0, 600)
	mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -250, 0.5, -300)
end

local function addCorner(parent, radius)
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
	corner.Parent = parent
end
addCorner(mainFrame, 12)

local shadow = Instance.new("Frame")
shadow.Name = "Shadow"
shadow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
shadow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0, 2)
shadow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
shadow.BorderSizePixel = 0
shadow.ZIndex = 0
shadow.Parent = mainFrame
addCorner(shadow, 12)

local titleBar = Instance.new("Frame")
titleBar.Name = "TitleBar"
titleBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
titleBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 45)
titleBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
titleBar.Parent = mainFrame
addCorner(titleBar, 12)

local titleBarBottomFix = Instance.new("Frame")
titleBarBottomFix.Name = "TitleBarBottomFix"
titleBarBottomFix.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12)
titleBarBottomFix.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -12)
titleBarBottomFix.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 45)
titleBarBottomFix.BorderSizePixel = 0
titleBarBottomFix.ZIndex = 1
titleBarBottomFix.Parent = titleBar

local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
titleLabel.Name = "TitleLabel"
titleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 200)
titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
titleLabel.Text = "epic’s hub"
titleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
titleLabel.ZIndex = 2
titleLabel.Parent = titleBar

local closeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
closeButton.Name = "CloseButton"
closeButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
closeButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
closeButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
closeButton.Text = "×"
closeButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
closeButton.ZIndex = 2
closeButton.Parent = titleBar

if isMobile then
	titleLabel.TextSize = 14
	titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -55, 1, 0)
	titleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
	
	closeButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 35, 0, 35)
	closeButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 7.5)
	closeButton.TextSize = 16
else
	titleLabel.TextSize = 18
	titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 1, 0)
	titleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 0)
	
	closeButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40)
	closeButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -45, 0, 5)
	closeButton.TextSize = 20
end

addCorner(closeButton, 8)
closeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() screenGui:Destroy() end)

-- Smooth Mobile and Desktop Dragging System
local dragging, dragStart, startPos = false, Vector2.new(0,0), UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)
titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = mainFrame.Position
		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
		end)
	end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
	end
end)

local tabContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
tabContainer.Name = "TabContainer"
tabContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
tabContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 50)
tabContainer.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 35)
tabContainer.BorderSizePixel = 0
tabContainer.Parent = mainFrame

local tabLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
tabLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
tabLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left
tabLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
tabLayout.Parent = tabContainer

local contentFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
contentFrame.Name = "ContentFrame"
contentFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -100)
contentFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 100)
contentFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30)
contentFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
contentFrame.Parent = mainFrame

local contentPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
contentPadding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10)
contentPadding.Parent = contentFrame

local mainView = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
mainView.Name = "MainView"
mainView.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0)
mainView.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
mainView.BackgroundTransparency = 1
mainView.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainView.ScrollBarThickness = 6
mainView.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 150)
mainView.Visible = true
mainView.Parent = contentFrame

local mainLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
mainLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
mainLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
mainLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
mainLayout.Parent = mainView

local credView = Instance.new("Frame")
credView.Name = "CredView"
credView.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
credView.BackgroundTransparency = 1
credView.Visible = false
credView.Parent = contentFrame

local credLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
credLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
credLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
credLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
credLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 12)
credLayout.Parent = credView

-- Tab State Tracking System
local currentActiveTabButton = nil
local function buildTabBtn(name, targetFrame)
	local tabBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	tabBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, isMobile and 110 or 150, 1, 0)
	tabBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 35)
	tabBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
	tabBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	tabBtn.TextSize = isMobile and 12 or 14
	tabBtn.Text = name
	tabBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	tabBtn.Parent = tabContainer
	addCorner(tabBtn, 6)
	
	tabBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		mainView.Visible = false
		credView.Visible = false
		targetFrame.Visible = true
		
		if currentActiveTabButton then
			currentActiveTabButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 35)
		end
		tabBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 50)
		currentActiveTabButton = tabBtn
	end)
	return tabBtn
end

local mainTabBtn = buildTabBtn("Main", mainView)
local credTabBtn = buildTabBtn("Credits", credView)
mainTabBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 50)
currentActiveTabButton = mainTabBtn

local function buildBtn(parent, text, callback)
	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 45)
	button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 80)
	button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	button.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	button.TextSize = 14
	button.Text = text
	button.BorderSizePixel = 0
	button.Parent = parent
	addCorner(button, 8)
	button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
end

-- ==========================================================
-- 6 DYNAMIC MAIN TAB TEMPLATE BUTTONS

for i = 1, 6 do
	buildBtn(mainView, "Custom Feature Script " .. i, function()
		task.spawn(function()

end
